label.en: Treasure Hunters title variants (Captain Hoo met)

note.zh: 2/12/8/16/9 以 base 继承 1/11/6/14/7 的描述与选项，只替换标题（pirate_events.txt:317, 702, 709, 949, 1038）；同一次触发只显示其中一种窗口。
note.en: 2/12/8/16/9 inherit 1/11/6/14/7 via base and only replace the title (pirate_events.txt:317, 702, 709, 949, 1038); only one window appears per trigger.

notes.zh: 与宝藏猎人起源已遇见霍船长的玩家，会改收 pirate.2/8/9/12/16（以 base 继承对应窗口、只覆盖标题，现已编译为文档）。
notes.en: Treasure Hunters empires that have met Captain Hoo receive pirate.2/8/9/12/16 instead (they inherit the matching window via base and only override the title; now compiled as docs).
